name: Brushed-Copper Over-Ear Headphones
description: A pair of over-ear headphones with matte charcoal-grey composite ear cups, a brushed-copper metal headband and hinges, and protein-leather cushioned earpads.
materials: matte charcoal-grey composite ear cups, brushed-copper metal headband and hinges, protein-leather cushioned earpads and headband padding
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, engraving, or printing anywhere on the ear cups, headband, or hinges; never render a third ear cup or a mismatched hinge finish; never omit the copper hinge detail
preservationNotes: the brushed-copper headband and hinge finish, matte charcoal ear-cup color, protein-leather cushioning, and completely plain unmarked surfaces must read identically in every angle, same hinge geometry throughout
